title: About Valeria
content:
About Valeria

Perspective shaped by responsibility, reinvention, and the work of leading well.

Valeria Mogildea is the founder of VALRISE Consulting, an executive advisory and leadership development firm for leaders navigating consequential decisions and meaningful transition.

A practical point of view

VALRISE is built on a simple belief: the strongest leadership work connects personal clarity to practical business judgment.

Valeria’s perspective is entrepreneurial, direct, and grounded in the realities leaders carry. She helps clients examine the decision beneath the noise, communicate with greater intention, and move forward without losing sight of the people affected.

Her work serves executives, founders, business owners, and emerging leaders. Women’s advancement is a signature specialty within a broader commitment to strong, responsible leadership.

How the work is approached

Clarity

Name what matters before deciding what to do.

Candor

Make room for honest perspective without losing respect or discretion.

Practicality

Translate insight into decisions, communication, and useful action.

title: Consulting
excerpt: Private executive advisory and leadership development for consequential moments.
content:
Consulting

Focused advisory for the decisions that shape what comes next.

VALRISE creates thoughtful space for leaders to examine complexity, sharpen judgment, and lead the next move with conviction.

01 / Executive Advisory

Private perspective for consequential decisions.

Designed for

CEOs, founders, entrepreneurs, and business owners navigating growth, transition, or a decision with lasting implications.

Situations addressed

Strategic clarity, competing priorities, leadership transitions, organizational choices, and the next chapter of a business.

Possible formats

Private advisory conversations or a focused series of sessions, shaped after an initial consultation.

02 / Leadership Development

Strengthen how leadership is understood and practiced.

Designed for

Senior and high-potential leaders preparing for broader scope, greater visibility, or organizational change.

Situations addressed

Executive presence, influence, decision-making, communication, accountability, and leading through change.

Possible formats

Individual development or a tailored engagement for an organization or leadership group.

03 / Women’s Leadership

Advance with confidence, visibility, and influence.

Designed for

Women moving toward executive, ownership, or board-level responsibility, and organizations investing in their advancement.

Situations addressed

Leadership voice, strategic visibility, stakeholder influence, confidence in high-stakes settings, and expanded responsibility.

Possible formats

Private development or an organizational program defined around the intended audience and context.

title: Speaking
excerpt: Leadership and entrepreneurship topics for organizations, founder communities, and events.
content:
Speaking

A grounded voice for leadership conversations that matter now.

Valeria Mogildea is available for leadership events, organizations, and founder communities seeking practical perspective on change, influence, and reinvention.

Invite Valeria to speak

Proposed topics

Leadership through change

How leaders create direction when circumstances, expectations, or the organization itself are moving.

Possible takeaways: steadier decision-making, clearer communication, and practical ways to lead amid uncertainty.

Entrepreneurial resilience and reinvention

A practical look at adapting identity, judgment, and priorities across chapters of business ownership.

Possible takeaways: recognizing inflection points, evaluating the next move, and separating reinvention from reaction.

Women, influence, and executive presence

How women can strengthen visibility and influence while leading with credibility and an authentic point of view.

Possible takeaways: communicating authority, navigating consequential rooms, and building strategic visibility.

Navigating the next chapter in business and leadership

How leaders can approach transition with clarity when the familiar path no longer fits the opportunity ahead.

Possible takeaways: defining what matters now, evaluating tradeoffs, and moving with intention.

Bring a relevant leadership conversation to your audience.

Invite Valeria to speak →
